headline: Fierce Fighting in Weathered Expanse; Colonials Hold Most Sectors
war_summary: Day 377 finds Colonials holding the great majority of the map's strategic bases, while Warden colours stand across a dozen regions, among them Basin Sionnach, Callums Cape, Clanshead Valley, Gutter, Howl County, Kuura Strand, Morgens Crossing, Olavis Wake, Pari Peak, Reaching Trail, Speaking Woods and Viper Pit, with majorities in Callahan's Passage (nine of ten), Mooring County (eleven of twelve), Nevish Line (seven of eight) and Palantine Berm (six of seven). The past twenty-four hours brought the heaviest ledger entries in Weathered Expanse, where roughly 9,870 Colonial and 10,647 Warden casualties were counted alongside forty-one base events, and in Mooring County, near 10,400 casualties on each side with thirty-one events. Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line each recorded several thousand casualties; Stlican Shelf logged fourteen events and Palantine Berm eleven, the latter split between both colours. More than half the regions reported no events whatever, and enlistment is moderating across the board. No shift in the broad balance of towns was recorded, the fighting remaining concentrated in a narrow band of contested sectors.
